title: A terminology or contract rename batch needs a whole-path sweep before its first freeze; today's record-id batch took ten review rounds of prose corrections on green gates
outcome: A terminology or contract rename batch needs a whole-path sweep before its first freeze; today's record-id batch took ten review rounds of prose corrections on green gates
acceptance: The engram-repo skill and .claude/commands/review-changes.md tell an implementer of a rename or contract-wording batch to sweep every occurrence of the old term across src, tests, scripts and docs (rg over the term and its variants) and to list the changed user-facing strings before the first freeze, so that reviewers judge one complete input rather than discovering adjacent occurrences round by round

The measurement the council named is recorded: rounds from first freeze to clean pair and repeat-terminology findings per changeset, with today's record-id batch (ten rounds, R7-R10 prose only, all gates green) and docs batch (four rounds) as the baseline in the item's notes
